components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action button — solid Moss Olive, white text, 44px min height.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">บันทึกรายงาน</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: oklch(0.48 0.15 132); color: oklch(1 0 0); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.415 0.148 132); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.48 0.15 132); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: oklch(0.935 0.014 130); color: oklch(0.5 0.022 130); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action paired with a primary button (e.g. Cancel next to Save).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.875 0.012 130); background: oklch(0.965 0.01 130); color: oklch(0.25 0.032 130); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.935 0.014 130); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.48 0.15 132); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: oklch(0.55 0.19 25); color: oklch(1 0 0); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; transition: opacity 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.19 25); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis inline action (sign out, switch role).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost">ออกจากระบบ</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.25 0.032 130); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.965 0.01 130); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Shared visual base for text input, textarea, and select.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="กรอกข้อมูล" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.875 0.012 130); background: oklch(1 0 0); padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: oklch(0.25 0.032 130); transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.5 0.022 130); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: oklch(0.5 0.022 130); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.48 0.15 132); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: oklch(0.48 0.15 132); } .ds-input:disabled { background: oklch(0.965 0.01 130); color: oklch(0.5 0.022 130); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Solid-fill semantic pill — meaning comes from color alone, never a stripe or icon.
components.css: .ds-pill-critical { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: oklch(0.55 0.19 25); color: oklch(1 0 0); }

components.name: Neutral Badge
components.description: Neutral pill for non-semantic tags and counts.

narrative.overview:
This is a tool for someone standing in direct midday sun with dusty gloves, filling in numbers before the next task starts. Every decision follows from that scene: high-contrast solid fills over subtlety, 44px minimum tap targets, one accent color spent sparingly so it still means something when it appears. The palette reads as construction-site material — sun-bleached ivory ground, moss-olive as the working brand color, baked-ember held in reserve for the moments that need to be noticed (priority, warnings, the rare accent action). Nothing here is decorative; every color, weight, and radius exists to make a number or a status legible fast, not to look impressive.

The system is restrained on purpose. A pure-white background carries almost the whole UI; moss-olive is the only color allowed to represent "brand" or a primary action; baked-ember is reserved for HIGH-priority and secondary-accent moments so it stays rare enough to still function as a flag. Nothing in the interface is imported from a generic SaaS-dashboard vocabulary — no gradients, no glassmorphism, no soft drop shadows layered on every card.
keyCharacteristics: Flat by default — borders and tonal surface steps carry structure, not shadows
One accent color (baked-ember), spent deliberately and rarely
Solid-fill semantic pills (priority/status) — meaning from color, never from stripes or gradients
44px minimum touch targets throughout, including secondary/ghost actions
Radius caps at 12px (rounded-md); full-round is reserved for pills only

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Baked Ember is the only saturated color besides the semantic status set. It marks HIGH priority and nothing else is allowed to borrow it for emphasis.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one typeface. Weight and size carry the entire hierarchy — never reach for a second font family to create emphasis.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows are not a general card treatment. shadow-sm is reserved for the small set of dashboard summary cards that need to read as "lifted" above the page; every other container stays flat with a hairline border.

rules.name: The 12px Ceiling Rule
rules.body: rounded-md (12px) is the standard radius for every substantial container: buttons, inputs, cards, panels, the EmptyState box. rounded-full is reserved exclusively for pills and badges.

dos: Do use rounded-md (12px) for every new container, button, or input — it's the system's one ceiling.
Do keep tap targets at min-h-[44px] for anything a user taps or clicks as a primary action; sm (36px) is the only sanctioned exception, for secondary/inline controls.
Do spend Baked Ember rarely — it should never cover more area on a screen than a pill or a small icon badge.
Do use the warm-ivory / warm-ivory-deep two-step surface system for layering, not a gray scale or new tint.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — the global stylesheet already collapses all animation/transition durations to near-zero; new motion must not bypass it.
donts: Don't introduce a shadow on an ordinary card, panel, or form. shadow-sm is reserved for the dashboard's summary-card set only.
Don't reach for a second typeface or a "display" font — this system carries its entire hierarchy in Inter's weight and size steps.

Don't use raw Tailwind palette classes (bg-amber-500/10, text-blue-700, border-purple-500/20, text-amber-900, etc.) for color. Known drift to clean up: the role badges in app-shell.tsx (getRoleBadge) and several panels in admin/page.tsx currently do this and should migrate to token-based equivalents rather than be treated as precedent.

Don't use rounded-lg (16px) for standard panels. admin/page.tsx's panel containers currently do this — inconsistent with the 12px ceiling used everywhere else — and should migrate to rounded-md rather than be copied forward.
